title: Find the secret inside a container
summary: A running container hides a secret code in its files. Go inside and find it.

tasks.title: `answer.txt` holds the secret code
tasks.hint: Open a shell inside: `docker exec -it vault sh`. Then look around `/var/lib/vault` with `ls -a`: files starting with a dot are hidden from plain `ls`. `cat` shows a file. Type `exit` to come back.

tasks.title: `vault` is still running
tasks.hint: Looking inside doesn't stop a container. If it stopped: `docker start vault`.
